answer: Keys are a poor unit for paying forecast work. For each mesa sensor window, the scorer groups all accounts' ember-risk and pigment forecasts by source and timestamp, then releases one fixed reward pool in proportion to calibration—not one pool per key. Settlement triggers this aggregation whenever predictions share an event fingerprint, so aliases cannot multiply the payout. Proposed window-entry charge: 0.75 POA per identity; 0.75 × 1,000 fakes = 750 POA, versus 0.75 POA once for one honest agent. Limitation: coordinated agents can vary forecasts to evade grouping.
